_evidence: Current menu and item state shared by the menu value save/compare/restore routines 0x0053ddbb/0x0053de6f/0x0053df39 (compose after menu_0084300a). ebx = [0x82fd34] is read with no null test (the callers 0x53c8fa / 0x53d350 / 0x53d47d only run them with a current menu; 0x53c8fa stores its esi menu there): a header from mhdr_0053ddbb whose item link enters the real static item chain of 0x84300a. Per item 'test byte [ebx+0x1e],1' selects the items: the +0x1e bytes of the 13 items (0x843040+0x1e and the real item strides; image values 0xc0/0xc2/0x60/0x61) mix bit 0 set and clear with the other bits the menu code uses (0x20/0x40/0x80). 'mov al,[ebx+0xd]; and eax,3' picks byte/word/dword/NUL string (menu_0084300a varies +0xd with all four low-bit values) and [ebx+0xe] is the static value 0x81e4f8 (items 1-5) or 0x7ab544 (items 6-13), read by save/compare and written by restore. Their four bytes each come from {0,1,2,0x41} (overriding the random dwords of menu_0084300a): a string then stops after 0..3 characters (otherwise at the image zero bytes 0x81e4fc / 0x7ab548, so no read leaves mapped data) and compare finds equal and different bytes.
